finalText:
All 12 application files are migrated. Only `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` still calls `db.query`.

I left that one alone: it's a vendored copy (`legacy-orm 2.1.4`) with a comment saying it's replaced wholesale on every upgrade and local edits are silently lost. Editing it wouldn't stick and isn't the right fix — if you want it off `db.query`, the real fix is either upgrading the vendored package to a version that uses `execute`, or wrapping/patching `db` at the point where it's injected into the adapter, not editing the vendor file directly. Let me know if you'd like me to look into either of those.
